note: Reducing Greenhouse Gases in the United States: A 2035 Emissions Target - an economy-wide target of 61-66 % below 2005 net GHG in 2035, whose entire range the NDC places on a straight line or steeper trajectory to net zero by 2050. The United States notified withdrawal from the Paris Agreement on 2025-01-27, effective 2026-01-27, so this is the last pathway the government itself communicated and the one the build uses for S2; the low end (61 %) is taken as the committed level and the range is not propagated. Quoted target text read directly from the UNFCCC registry PDF.
Australia updated NDC (2022): 43% below 2005 levels by 2030, net zero by 2050. A 2035 target (62-70% below 2005) was announced in 2025; use the registry text as the anchor once verified.
